title: Polish Cyrillic
description: Adds a language for polish written in cyrillic. / Dodaje język dla polskiego pisanego cyrlicą.
body:
## Polish Cyrillic
Adds a language for polish written in cyrillic. <small>/ Dodaje język dla polskiego pisanego cyrlicą.</small>  
Look for `Полски (Полска)` next to normal polish in the language menu. <small>/ Szukać `Полски (Полска)` koło normalnego polskiego w menu języków.</small>

### Transcription method <small>/ Metoda transkrypcji</small>
It's mostly based on russian. <small>/ Jest w większości oparta na rosyjskim.</small>

- ł = ў
- ą = ѧ (iotated <small>/ jotowane</small>: ѩ)
- ę = ѫ (iotated <small>/ jotowane</small>: ѭ)
- ó = у
- ch = х
- h = г
- g = ґ
- rz = ж
- dż = drz = дж
- dz = дз
- dź = дзь
- ć = ть

Other exceptions were accounted for, e.g. `minecraft` = `майнкрафт` ≠ `минэцрафт`. <small>/ Inne wyjątki są uwzględnione, np. `minecraft` = `майнкрафт` ≠ `минэцрафт`.</small>

Made using [this python script](https://gist.github.com/Blayung/4864b20abc4b46760dfd4eff861798fe). <small>/ Stworzone przy użyciu [tego skryptu python](https://gist.github.com/Blayung/4864b20abc4b46760dfd4eff861798fe).</small>
